capabilities.summary: Installation identity with clone detection and startup claim, build identity (git rev, dirty flag, profile, channel, UTC stamp), device pairing with signed transcript, owner approval and resume tickets, bearer-token device auth with per-IP rate limit
policyNotes: Declaration-only: apps call this crate instead of writing their own install ids, pairing transcripts or bearer-token checks.
Key agreement is out of scope: the caller supplies the shared secret.
